decision_conditions:
BREEAM pre assessment; BRE daylight and sunlight assessment required.

Please update proposed ground floor and basement plans to remove the change of use if not applying for this. 

We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree? 
'Construction of rear extension to first and second floors to existing flat and to create an additional self-contained 2 bedroom flat; installation of roof lights and solar panels'.

Demolition plans required; For Buildings of Townscape Merit, or Conservation Areas.

Detailed plans required (scale not less than 1:20) must show new doors, windows, shop fronts, panelling, fireplaces, plaster mouldings, and other decorative features.
